note: Evaluation fixtures. Each case states what a correct diagnosis must detect. Expectations are written by hand and deliberately include easy negatives, because a detector that flags everything has perfect recall and no value.

cases.description: Generic productivity tooling with no category pairing
cases.document:
# Taskly

A productivity app for busy people. Track your habits, manage tasks, and stay focused. Beautiful design, cross-platform sync, dark mode included.

cases.description: Explicit repositioning; must NOT be flagged as weak category
cases.document:
# Ledgerline

It's not an invoicing tool. It's late-payment recovery for freelance contractors who cannot afford to chase clients.

If a client is 14 days late, Ledgerline drafts the escalation email you are avoiding.

## Install

npm install -g ledgerline

This fails if contractors read it as a collections agency.

cases.description: Useful tool with no community or tribe cue at all
cases.document:
# PixelDiff

A command line tool that compares two PNG files and prints the percentage of changed pixels. Supports alpha channel and anti-aliasing tolerance. Written in Rust. 42 unit tests.

# GrowthGenius

The guaranteed viral growth engine trusted by 10,000 professionals. Revolutionary game-changing AI that will 10x your audience. This repo will reach 100K stars.

cases.description: Confident launch copy with no stated failure mode
cases.document:
# ShipLog

It's not a changelog. It's a release narrative for developer-facing products.

Write a changelog entry once and ShipLog renders it for your docs, your blog and your release notes.

npm install shiplog

cases.description: Negative case: honest warnings must never be flagged as inflation
cases.document:
# Honest tool

This cannot guarantee viral growth. Nobody can promise 100K stars. It does not invent statistics and it will tell you not to launch.

What it does: names the weakest lever in your launch.

# Orbital

A framework for building things. Fast. Flexible. Modern. Everyone can use it. Works with anything.
